source: Korea Herald — BOK 2026 growth outlook preview
evidence: Given the stronger-than-expected exports led by semiconductors, increased government expenditure driven by higher tax revenues and a rebound in domestic demand, the country is likely to achieve economic growth of around 3 percent this year. — Ahn Jae-kyun, Korea Investment & Securities (analyst consensus previewing a BOK 2026 growth-outlook revision from 2.6% to 3.0-3.4%)
